title: TwoStep Therapeutics
summary: TwoStep Therapeutics is a biotechnology company developing a pipeline built around a versatile targeting peptide that selectively binds multiple tumor-associated integrins—a unique feature that enables the delivery of diverse payloads across a wide range of solid tumor types. The company leverages this technology to develop targeted cancer therapies for cytotoxic drug delivery and radioligand therapy.
body_markdown:
[Active Portfolio Companies](https://www.pfizer.com/taxonomy/term/11726)


TwoStep Therapeutics is a biotechnology company developing a pipeline built around a versatile targeting peptide that selectively binds multiple tumor-associated integrins—a unique feature that enables the delivery of diverse payloads across a wide range of solid tumor types. The company leverages this technology to develop targeted cancer therapies for cytotoxic drug delivery and radioligand therapy.


San Carlos, California[https://twosteptx.com/](https://twosteptx.com/)
